lessons.lesson: Review every held position each run from its `stop` block, not by hand. lessons.lesson: When the Market Analyst's same-day note contradicts the role a held position's thesis gives it (e.g. 'hedge for an equity drawdown' while he says bonds are falling with stocks), don't defend the hold with that role. Restate the role through thesis_updates or name the position as a sell candidate.

news_memory.text: Watching Clorox Shares; Traders Circulate M&A Chatter: This repeats the 11-10 unsourced M&A-blog rumor. There is still no filing or named outlet, so treat it as rumor premium.

'Fed Is Fighting the Wrong Inflation': Strategist Warns Kevin Warsh Against 'Reckless' 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike After Hotter-Than-Expected October CPI: Commentary on the 11-10 CPI print with no new datum. The hike-path risk for TLT, IEF, BND and VNQ is unchanged, and the next hard event is the 12-09 FOMC.

Held. Company-confirmed now: 'Walmart Announces Third Quarter Earnings Call Date' (fiscal.ai, 11-12) puts the release and call on 11-19. That matches the file estimate (last year + 364 days) and closes the open-date question flagged 11-10 to 11-12. It is 4 trading days out (11-16, 17, 18, 19), so it is high risk for any add. PT drift keeps building: Wells Fargo raised to $135 from $120 today, after BofA $139, Baird $140, Gordon Haskett $130, BTIG $140, UBS $149, JPMorgan $145, BMO $136 and Mizuho $135 in the last week. That is nine or more raises in five sessions, so the bar for the print is high. No filings. The PM's L7 note still applies: a close-based stop does not protect against a gap on the print.

The Huang thread that began 11-09 has resolved into a resignation. Kress is interim CEO, and Trump publicly floated Tim Cook. NVDA fell as much as 14.3% on 11-12 and closed about -5%, and the Nasdaq 100 actually turned green as AMD and Broadcom rallied. Nine banks cut NVDA targets; Evercore went to $186 from $465. Nvidia reports 11-17 (11-11 Benzinga 'Nov. 17 earnings'), 2 trading days out. It is the index's largest AI weight, and its first print under an interim CEO is the dated catalyst. Futures were mixed to slightly up this morning (Polymarket 55% for a higher open), and ETF inflows were $37.5B in five days with VOO and QQQ leading. Caveat from my graded record: QQQ high flags from 10-30 to 11-04 graded wrong at 5 days in four of five cases. Read this as event risk around a dated print, not as a direction call.

A fourth leg down. After $75K broke on 11-09, it slid to $73K after CPI (11-10), fell below $72K/$73K on the Nvidia report (11-12), and is now below $69K overnight. More than $1B in liquidations, ETF outflows, and Iran tensions after Trump said 'we don't need a deal with Iran'. The 11-10 'Can Bitcoin hold $70,000' level has been lost, so the 11-11 and 11-12 downside warnings played out again. The MSCI removal of Strategy (confirmed 11-12) is still weighing; MSTR fell 6-7%. Exchange-failure clause: untripped. The FBI's report of a $400M North Korean deepfake-call theft targets individuals and Web3 professionals, not an exchange, and the TSMC ransom-in-BTC item is irrelevant. Bullish items (Adam Back $1M by 2028) are opinion. Not known whether a BTC position is still live after the ~11-09 sale; if it is, the PM must compute the mark against its stop.
Fell with BTC (about -6% with XRP, per the 11-13 'Bitcoin Implodes to $69,000' piece). No ETH-specific event; the same rates, ETF-outflow and Nvidia drivers apply.

No VOO-specific event. Nvidia is the S&P's largest weight; its CEO has resigned and it reports 11-17, 2 trading days out. VOO led the $37.5B five-day ETF inflow (dip-buying), which is flows, not an event. Treasury yields jumped again on 11-12. Iran rhetoric is a new geopolitical overhang, although oil eased this morning.
Tagged in the ETF-inflow story only. Same backdrop as VOO, including the NVDA 11-17 print.

Continues the CPI thread (10-year at 5% on 11-10, BofA puts 50bp on the table, Benzinga cites 99% odds of a hike at the 12-09 FOMC). The only new datum is that 'Treasury yields jumped' on 11-12 (Nasdaq-100 recap); no level is given. The next dated catalyst is the 12-09 FOMC, outside the window. Unchanged from 11-12.
Same hike-path risk at shorter duration. No IEF-tagged item since the 11-11 Thorne opinion piece. Yields rose again on 11-12 (no figure in the input).
Same rates backdrop at the lowest duration. No BND headline.
Held per recent notes. No VNQ headline. It stays rate-sensitive with yields rising again on 11-12 and 50bp-hike talk for 12-09.

New: gold fell to a one-year low, below $4,000, on 11-12 ('Gold Stocks Dip', 'Gold Falls Below $4000'). Benzinga attributes it to fading Middle East peace hopes; a rising-yield, hike-pricing backdrop also weighs on a non-yielding asset. I raised this from low because the move is a regime-level break for the sleeve, not an event with a date. The file's 11-24 'earnings' date is a data artifact for an ETF.

The 8-K 5.02/9.01 filed 11-10 (document dated 11-05) is still unread: the input gives only item numbers and no headline explains it. Estimated earnings 11-23 (approximate), 6 trading days out, one day outside the window. Not known to be held.

New 8-K 5.02 filed 11-12 (document dated 11-10), with no headline. It could be an executive departure or an appointment; I can't tell from item numbers. It reported 11-05; next estimate 2027-02-25. Flag it for any proposal on FTDR until the content is known. Not known to be held.

Inference: that item set (material agreement, direct financial obligation, unregistered equity) fits the closing of the $1.1B 1.25% convertible notes priced 11-10, not a new deal. The 11-05 8-K has aged out unread. A trust filed a Form 144 to sell about 444,440 shares (11-12), a mild sentiment negative. Next 2027-02-18. Not known to be held.

Agreed to buy P1 Construction in an all-cash deal (terms not disclosed), with expected 2026 revenue of $600M-$650M and adj. EBITDA of about $60M. Close is expected Q1 2027. That is a bolt-on relative to an approx. $29B market cap, so it is not a 'large' 1.01 on its face. No 8-K in the window yet. Next 2027-02-25.

Walmart Announces Third Quarter Earnings Call Date (November 19, 2026): This closes the date question flagged since 11-10: the estimate was right, and 11-19 is now company-confirmed, 4 trading days out on a held name. Together with today's Wells Fargo raise to $135, the pre-print sentiment is crowded bullish. The PM asked on 11-12 for a one-third trim before the print; this confirmation removes the 'date unverified' excuse either way.

Wall Street Takes the Chainsaw to Nvidia Targets: One Bank Slashes $465 to $186; Nasdaq 100 Turns Green Despite Nvidia's 5% Drop on Huang Exit: The 11-12 succession report escalated to a resignation within a day, so that flag came true. The index absorbed it: NVDA recovered from -14.3% to about -5% and the Nasdaq 100 closed green, with AMD and Broadcom bid. The dated risk is now Nvidia's 11-17 print under an interim CEO, which hits the QQQ, VOO and VTI sleeves through concentration.

Bitcoin Implodes to $69,000, Ethereum, XRP Down on ETF Outflows, Nvidia Turmoil: This is the fourth leg since 11-09 ($75K, then $73K, then $72K, now below $69K), and the $70K level that Benzinga framed on 11-10 has gone. The drivers are rates, ETF outflows, the Nvidia shock, Iran and the Strategy index removal. No exchange failed, so a qualitative exchange-failure clause stays untripped. My BTC flags graded mixed at 5 days (right 11-04 and 11-06, wrong 11-02 and 11-03), so treat this as risk-watch, not a forecast.

Gold Stocks Dip: What's Going On? (gold at a one-year low); Nvidia Crisis ... Gold Falls Below $4000: This is the first gold-specific move in the window, and it breaks a big round number. The cited cause is fading Middle East peace hopes. A gold sleeve, if held, is not behaving as a geopolitical hedge this week. That is one observation, not graded evidence.

Baird Upgrades Domino's Pizza to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $400: A rating upgrade on a held name. It is the first fresh sell-side catalyst since the unconfirmed 10-30 guidance-cut item, which I closed as having come to nothing on 11-11. It is supportive and does not change event risk (next print 2027-02-22).

Deutsche Bank Downgrades CVS Health to Neutral, Cuts PT to $104 from $116: This continues the 11-10 and 11-12 thread (Argus $105, Wells Fargo $112). It is now a rating cut, not just PT trims, so negative revisions after the print are broadening. It is a trend rather than an event. Not known to be held.

EMCOR To Acquire P1 Construction In All-Cash Deal; P1 Expected To Generate 2026 Revenue Of $600M-$650M, Adj. EBITDA Of ~$60M: A bolt-on of roughly 4% revenue scale relative to EME, all cash, closing Q1 2027 with the price undisclosed. It is a modest integration and leverage item, not a thesis change. Watch for an 8-K 1.01 if the price turns out to be material.

Loop Capital Upgrades Autodesk to Buy, Announces $310 Price Target: A supportive rating change 7 trading days before the estimated 11-24 print. If ADSK is proposed, it enters the 5-day high-risk window on 11-17.
8-K item 5.02 filed 2026-11-12 (no headline): This is an officer or director change I can't read from item numbers. It deserves a check before any FTDR proposal, as with BLBD's unread 5.02.

Nasdaq 100 Turns Green ... while AMD and Broadcom rallied and Treasury yields jumped: Yields rose again on 11-12, two sessions after the hot CPI, on a day equities held up. That repeats the 11-10 and 11-12 pattern the Market Analyst noted, with bonds weak while stocks were steady or up. No new dated rates event before the 12-09 FOMC.

Held. Q3 release and call 11-19 are company-confirmed (11-12 item; the file estimate agrees), 3 trading days out (11-17, 18, 19), so any add carries high risk. New today: an 8-K 5.02/9.01 filed 11-16 (document dated 11-13) with no explaining headline. It could be a director appointment or an executive departure; I can't tell which from item numbers, and it lands three days before the print. The PM should read it before relying on the WMT thesis. Today's 'What's Going On With Walmart Stock Monday?' piece says shares are up premarket and doesn't mention it. PT drift continues: BNP Paribas to $144 from $137 (11-16) and Wells Fargo $135 (11-13), on top of the 9+ raises noted 11-13. The bar is high, and a close-based stop does not protect against a gap on the print (L7).

Nvidia reports 11-17, 1 trading day out (date from earlier Benzinga items; today's input doesn't restate it). It is the first print under interim CEO Kress after Huang's resignation. New policy pressure: Treasury Secretary Bessent is pressing Nvidia over China chips (11-16 premarket), and today's analyst roundup includes more NVDA target cuts. On 11-13 the post-Huang chip rotation unwound: AMD fell 10.5% and the Nasdaq 100 fell 1.7%. Polymarket put a higher S&P open at 38% this morning. Caveat from my graded record: QQQ high flags graded wrong at 5 days in most cases since 10-30 (including 11-06). This is event risk around a dated print, not a direction call.

Fifth leg down since 11-09: $75K, $73K, below $69K on 11-13, below $70K/$68K Friday, and $64K this morning after a 'brutal weekend selloff' (Benzinga: down about 25%, heavy liquidations). The crypto market lost about $750B in days, Fear & Greed is 17, spot crypto ETFs lost $1.48B in five days (BTC $1.06B), and CZ cites $1.9B in outflows. O'Leary and CZ blame capital rotating to AI and the Anthropic IPO. The Polymarket $65K target from 11-13 has effectively been hit. Exchange-failure clause: untripped, since no exchange failed in this input. Calls for $40K (Cowen) and sub-$10K (Schiff) are opinion. Not held since the ~11-09 sale per the lessons file.

Raised from medium because there are now ETH-specific items: a death cross, ETH ETF outflows and a dive in futures open interest (11-14). It is also on every crypto-crash roundup. No exchange or protocol failure.

Estimated earnings 11-23 (last year + 364 days, approximate), now 5 trading days out (11-17, 18, 19, 20, 23), so it is inside the window for a new buy. The 8-K 5.02/9.01 filed 11-10 is still unread with no headline; that open question has carried since 11-11. Not known to be held.

Flows remain strong ('VOO & Chill', the $37.5B five-day ETF inflow), and SCHD's $27.5B inflow is read as rotation away from AI. My 11-06 high VOO flag graded wrong.

Same thread as BND at the longest duration: the 10-year was at 5.15% and hikes are priced for December and January. No TLT-tagged item. The 12-09 FOMC is outside the window.

8-K items 5.02/9.01 filed 2026-11-16 (document dated 11-13), no headline: This is the first 5.02 on a held name in weeks, and it lands three trading days before a confirmed print. Until the content is known, an executive departure can't be ruled out. It continues the WMT pre-print thread (dates flagged 11-10 to 11-13), which so far has been all bullish PT drift.

BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target on Walmart to $144 From $137; Walmart Stock Forms a Golden Cross as Valuation Worries Linger Ahead of Earnings: Another pre-print raise, roughly the eleventh in seven sessions. Consensus is crowded, so the print has to clear a high bar.

Incyte Has Decided Not To Proceed With The Planned Phase 3 MAESTRA-3 Study Evaluating INCB123667; Company Does Not Expect This Determination To Affect Its Financial Guidance: A pipeline negative on a position bought 11-11, backed by the 8-K 8.01 of 11-13. The company explicitly keeps guidance, so it is not a guidance cut. It matters for the oncology pair (INCY+EXEL) the PM sized as one exposure.

Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Exelixis, Lowers Price Target to $57: A target below both the $69.04 fill and the $65 stop on a position bought 11-13. Not an event, but it adds to the INCY item for the Health Care/oncology sleeve the same day.

Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 Futures Trade Fall as Scott Bessent Presses Nvidia Over China Chips: A new policy angle on Nvidia the day before its 11-17 print, adding to the Huang resignation thread (11-09 to 11-13). It follows Friday's chip unwind (AMD -10.5%, Nasdaq 100 -1.7%), so the 11-13 'index absorbed it' read lasted one session.

Bitcoin Drops to $64,000 After Brutal Weekend Selloff: What Is Going On?: The fifth leg of the thread that began 11-09. Each downside warning in news_memory ($73K, $70K, $65K Polymarket) has played out within days. The drivers are flows (ETF outflows, liquidations, rotation to AI/Anthropic IPO) and rates, not an exchange failure.
Ethereum Flashes Death Cross as ETF Outflows Surge, Futures Open Interest Dives: The first ETH-specific item in the window. ETH is no longer only riding BTC's tags.

Behind the Rising US Bond Yields: Traders Bet on Fed Hikes in December and January, a Blow to Trump: This extends the CPI thread (11-10 onward) from one hike to two, with the 10-year at 5.15%. It bears on BND and the equity sleeves; the 11-13 cooler PPI is the only offsetting datum.

Goldman Sachs Says Wait With Gold Until 2027; China Isn't Listening: Continues the 11-13 sub-$4,000 break. A major-bank target trim and GLD outflows against central-bank buying. It is a regime question, not a dated event.
Evercore ISI Group Maintains Outperform on Kroger, Raises Price Target to $75: Supportive on a held name after the 11-13 add, following Goldman's $77. No event before the 12-03 call.

RBC Lowers Price Target on CVS Health to $108 From $113: The fourth negative revision since 11-10 (Argus, Wells Fargo, the Deutsche Bank downgrade, RBC). The post-print drift is persistent but is a trend, not an event.
ExlService Form 4 Filing Showed Chairman And CEO Rohit Kapoor Sold 100,000 Shares At $43.24: The Form 144 flagged on 11-13 has executed, closing that item. A mild negative.
